date_scope_check.qualification_retained: The March 16–17 phase concerns the initial interruption for pilgrims and residents returning to Yemen. Contemporary reporting specifies closure on March 16 at night and reopening by March 17 afternoon, supporting exclusion of this initial phase from strict greater-than-24-hours records; exact hours remain unknown. Midnight reclosure was prospective and a March 18 report describes continuing pilgrim exceptions. May 7 is a formal special-returnee permission; subsequent official reporting confirms admissions but not their exact first time. SABA dates the renewed temporary passenger-closure announcement to Thursday May 14, resolving the consular notice’s later May 17 posting date. Freight and coordinated special cases remained excepted. June IOM reporting establishes further limited returnee access while ordinary civilian restrictions remained. These observations do not form a continuous all-passenger closure; national policy repeal and unrestricted restoration remain unknown.
